name: updown-contracts
description: Task runner only. No dependencies — this repo is pure Foundry. Do not add hardhat back.

scripts.handoff:prod: set -a && . ./.env.prod && set +a && printf 'PROD: start the Ownable2Step handoff of the LIVE stack to OWNER_ADDRESS (reversible until accepted). Type yes to continue: ' && read ans && [ "$ans" = yes ] && forge script script/TransferOwnership.s.sol --rpc-url "$ARBITRUM_RPC_URL" --broadcast
scripts.preflight:dev: set -a && . ./.env.dev && set +a && [ -n "$EXISTING_SETTLEMENT_ADDRESS" ] || { echo 'EXISTING_SETTLEMENT_ADDRESS is unset. For a resolver/cycler upgrade it MUST be set to the live Settlement, or deploy:dev creates a NEW Settlement and orphans the existing one.'; exit 1; } && forge script script/UpgradePreflight.s.sol --rpc-url "$ARBITRUM_RPC_URL"
scripts.preflight:prod: set -a && . ./.env.prod && set +a && [ -n "$EXISTING_SETTLEMENT_ADDRESS" ] || { echo 'EXISTING_SETTLEMENT_ADDRESS is unset. For a resolver/cycler upgrade it MUST be set to the live Settlement, or deploy:prod creates a NEW Settlement and strands all user collateral on the old one.'; exit 1; } && forge script script/UpgradePreflight.s.sol --rpc-url "$ARBITRUM_RPC_URL"
scripts.simulate:dev: set -a && . ./.env.dev && set +a && DEPLOY_LABEL=dev forge script script/Deploy.s.sol --rpc-url "$ARBITRUM_RPC_URL"
scripts.simulate:prod: set -a && . ./.env.prod && set +a && DEPLOY_LABEL=prod forge script script/Deploy.s.sol --rpc-url "$ARBITRUM_RPC_URL"
scripts.deploy:dev: set -a && . ./.env.dev && set +a && [ -n "$ARBISCAN_API_KEY" ] || { echo 'ARBISCAN_API_KEY is empty — --verify would fail AFTER broadcasting. Set it or drop --verify.'; exit 1; } && WRITE_DEPLOYMENT_RECORD=1 DEPLOY_LABEL=dev forge script script/Deploy.s.sol --rpc-url "$ARBITRUM_RPC_URL" --broadcast --verify --retries 10 --delay 20
scripts.deploy:prod: set -a && . ./.env.prod && set +a && [ -n "$ARBISCAN_API_KEY" ] || { echo 'ARBISCAN_API_KEY is empty — --verify would fail AFTER broadcasting. Set it or drop --verify.'; exit 1; } && printf 'PROD deploy: Arbitrum One, REAL USDT, live users. Type yes to continue: ' && read ans && [ "$ans" = yes ] && WRITE_DEPLOYMENT_RECORD=1 DEPLOY_LABEL=prod forge script script/Deploy.s.sol --rpc-url "$ARBITRUM_RPC_URL" --broadcast --verify --retries 10 --delay 20
scripts.verify:dev: set -a && . ./.env.dev && set +a && DEPLOY_LABEL=dev forge script script/Deploy.s.sol --rpc-url "$ARBITRUM_RPC_URL" --verify --resume --retries 10 --delay 20
scripts.verify:prod: set -a && . ./.env.prod && set +a && DEPLOY_LABEL=prod forge script script/Deploy.s.sol --rpc-url "$ARBITRUM_RPC_URL" --verify --resume --retries 10 --delay 20
